# Support matrix by API option

<!-- Generated by python3 dnn-providers/integration-tests/scripts/support_features/feature_matrix.py; edit the script, not this file. -->

Generated from the committed support claims (11174 graphs, 486 catalogued options). Percentages are shares of each op's API options, not of its graphs. Options count singly, not in combination.

**Jump to:** [RDNA (consumer)](#rdna-consumer) · [CDNA (data center)](#cdna-data-center) · [By engine](#by-engine) · [Op groups](#op-groups) · [Options per op](#options-per-op) · [GPU targets](#gpu-targets)

## Summary by architecture

- **Op group (options)**: the number is how many options the group's ops offer in the API (data types, mask modes, layouts, optional inputs, ...), catalogued from the flatbuffers schema. Each option is counted once and listed in [Options per op](#options-per-op), split into those a test graph uses and those none does.
- **GPU columns**: share of those options used by at least one graph that an engine claims on that GPU and OS. `✅` all · `🟡 45%` 45% · `❌` none. GPUs with the most options claimed come first. Combinations aren't measured: a GPU can cover fp8 and causal masking in separate graphs without any graph testing them together.
- A group's share pools its ops' options, so one op can fill it while no graph tests another: [Op groups](#op-groups) names those ops.

## Options per op

Every API option the percentages count, catalogued per op in `dnn-providers/integration-tests/scripts/support_features/<op>.py`. An option is one choice a graph can make for an op: a data type (`dtype:bf16`), a mode (`mask:causal_top_left`), a tensor-shape case (`heads:gqa`), or an optional input or output (`out:stats`). *Test graph* means a graph in `integration-test-bundles/`, any tier, claimed or not. An option no test graph uses cannot be claimed on any GPU until one does.

| Op (options) | Used by a test graph | Used by no test graph |
|---|---|---|
| <a id="op-batchnorm"></a>**Batchnorm** (20) | `dtype:fp32`, `dtype:fp16`, `dtype:bf16`, `spatial:1d`, `spatial:2d`, `spatial:3d`, `layout:nchw`, `layout:nhwc`, `affine:full_rank`, `affine:reduced_rank`, `epsilon:fixed`, `epsilon:runtime`, `running_stats:on`, `momentum:fixed`, `momentum:runtime`, `out:mean`, `out:inv_variance` | `precision:mixed`, `spatial:none`, `peer_stats:on` |
